context: Two coworkers discuss the new office floor layout
purpose: Teach: デスク/ルーム/扉/電波/交代/パック/タウン/大抵

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新しいフロアのレイアウト見た？私のデスク、窓際に移動してたよ。
lines.en: Did you see the new floor layout? My desk got moved to by the window.
lines.style: Bright, slightly excited female voice sharing news with a coworker.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 本当？俺の席は会議ルームの真横でさ、扉の音がうるさそうで嫌だな。
lines.en: Really? My seat is right next to the meeting room, and the door sounds will probably be annoying.
lines.style: Mid-toned male voice with a mild complaining undertone throughout.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: あー、あの辺りって電波も悪いんだよね。スマホが大抵繋がらないって聞いたよ。
lines.en: Ah, the signal is bad around there too. I heard phones usually don't connect.
lines.style: Sympathetic, casual female tone offering insider information to him.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: マジか…。じゃあ電話番の交代したい時、誰にも連絡できないじゃん。
lines.en: Seriously? Then when I want to swap phone duty shifts, I can't reach anyone.
lines.style: Slightly exasperated male voice realizing a downside of relocation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ねえ、お昼どうする？一階のタウン側に新しいお弁当屋できたの知ってる？
lines.en: Hey, what about lunch? Did you know a new bento shop opened on the town-facing side of the first floor?
lines.style: Switching topics cheerfully, female voice with friendly lunch invitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 知らなかった。日替わりパックとかある感じ？安かったら毎日通うわ。
lines.en: I didn't know. Do they have daily set packs? If it's cheap, I'll go every day.
lines.style: Interested male voice, practical and hungry-sounding response to news.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: あるある、五百円のパックが人気らしいよ。じゃあ一緒に行こ？
lines.en: Yeah they do, the five-hundred-yen pack is apparently popular. Wanna go together?
lines.style: Enthusiastic female voice confirming details and inviting him along.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 行く行く。久しぶりに外の空気吸いたかったし、ちょうどよかった。
lines.en: Definitely. I've been wanting some fresh air for a while, so the timing's perfect.
lines.style: Agreeable male voice, relaxed and looking forward to the break.
